notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Servos.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
description:
Activate Zabaz's first ability by paying {R}, destroying another artifact creature you control.
When the creature dies, Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Servos to start the combo, this combo nets infinite mana.
